faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Deputy Chief Law Officer post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Deputy Chief Law Officer position at Visakhapatnam Port Authority is 09-10-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree in Law from a recognized University with nine years of executive experience in a legal establishment. A Post Graduate Degree in Law is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the Deputy Chief Law Officer post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Deputy Chief Law Officer post is 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable for existing employees of Major Port Authorities.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Deputy Chief Law Officer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary in the pay scale of Rs. 60000 to Rs. 180000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Deputy Chief Law Officer post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy available for the Deputy Chief Law Officer post in the Visakhapatnam Port Authority.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Examination followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. In which mode can candidates apply for this job?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply for this recruitment through the Online mode only.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of Visakhapatnam Port Authority?
faq.answer: The official website of Visakhapatnam Port Authority is https://vpt.shipping.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is No.C2/Rectl/Dy.CLO/GAD/2026.
